answer: Nobody is waved through free: 95 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked is the price, and the signal never covers it twice. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Accredited archivist pendulum token sees to it, since a token archivists wear after archive audits. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. One quill, one entry. The clerk notes oasis.
